<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover">
<title>The Black Dots</title>
<meta name="claude:viewport-fit-sides" content="cover">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Rye&family=Bitter:ital,wght@0,400;0,600;0,800;1,400&family=Kalam:wght@400;700&display=swap">
<style>
/* Layout: a country general-store page. Feed-sack sign at the top, a sunrise behind the book,
   gingham ribbons between sections, recipe-card story tiles, and a front-porch call to buy. */
:root{
  --paper:#F6E7C8;      /* feed-sack cream */
  --paper-2:#EED9AE;    /* deeper cream */
  --barn:#A8322A;       /* barn red */
  --barn-dk:#7C2019;
  --mustard:#E0A426;    /* sunrise mustard */
  --denim:#2F4A63;      /* overalls blue */
  --pine:#3E5B3A;       /* porch green */
  --ink:#3A2617;        /* coffee-brown ink */
  --ink-soft:#6B5038;
  --white:#FFF9EC;
  --display:"Rye","Bitter",Georgia,serif;
  --body:"Bitter",Georgia,"Times New Roman",serif;
  --hand:"Kalam","Comic Sans MS",cursive;
  color-scheme:light;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
body{margin:0;background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--body);font-size:1.0625rem;line-height:1.65;
  background-image:radial-gradient(rgba(124,32,25,.05) 1px,transparent 1.2px);background-size:7px 7px}
a{color:var(--barn)}
a:focus-visible,button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--denim);outline-offset:3px}
.wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;padding-left:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-left,0px));padding-right:max(16px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px))}
h1,h2,h3{text-wrap:balance;margin:0}
h2{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(1.8rem,4.4vw,2.7rem);line-height:1.15;color:var(--barn)}
p{margin:0}
.eyebrow{font-family:var(--body);font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;font-size:.8rem;color:var(--denim)}
.hand{font-family:var(--hand)}

/* gingham ribbon */
.gingham{height:22px;background:
  repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(168,50,42,.55) 0 11px,transparent 11px 22px),
  repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(168,50,42,.55) 0 11px,transparent 11px 22px),var(--white)}

/* top sign */
.sign{background:var(--barn);color:var(--white)}
.sign .wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding-block:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.sign b{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.04em;font-size:1.05rem}
.sign span{font-size:.9rem;opacity:.95}

/* buttons */
.btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:800;font-size:1.05rem;border-radius:999px;padding:14px 24px;border:3px solid var(--ink);transition:transform .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease}
.btn.buy{background:var(--barn);color:var(--white);box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--ink)}
.btn.watch{background:var(--mustard);color:var(--ink);box-shadow:4px 4px 0 var(--ink)}
.btn:hover{transform:translate(-2px,-2px);box-shadow:6px 6px 0 var(--ink)}
.btn svg{width:22px;height:22px;flex:none}

/* hero */
.hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:
  repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg at 28% 62%,rgba(224,164,38,.30) 0deg 7deg,transparent 7deg 15deg),
  radial-gradient(circle at 28% 62%,#F7C65C 0 16%,rgba(247,198,92,.0) 46%),var(--paper-2)}
.hero .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,5fr) minmax(0,6fr);gap:clamp(24px,5vw,56px);align-items:center;padding-block:clamp(32px,6vw,64px)}
.cover{position:relative;justify-self:center;max-width:320px;width:100%}
.cover img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:1000/1491;object-fit:cover;border-radius:4px;border:6px solid var(--white);box-shadow:10px 12px 0 var(--ink);transform:rotate(-2.5deg)}
.cover .tag{position:absolute;right:-14px;top:18px;background:var(--mustard);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--display);font-size:.95rem;line-height:1.1;text-align:center;width:104px;height:104px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;border:3px solid var(--ink);transform:rotate(12deg);padding:10px}
.hero-copy{display:grid;gap:18px;min-width:0}
.hero h1{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;color:var(--ink);font-size:clamp(2.6rem,7.5vw,5rem);line-height:.95;letter-spacing:.01em}
.hero h1 small{display:block;font-family:var(--body);font-style:italic;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(1.15rem,2.4vw,1.5rem);color:var(--barn-dk);letter-spacing:0;margin-top:12px;line-height:1.3}
.byline{font-weight:600}
.byline em{font-style:normal;color:var(--denim)}
.lede{max-width:56ch;font-size:1.12rem}
.rooster-perch{position:absolute;right:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-right,0px));bottom:0;width:clamp(120px,17vw,190px);pointer-events:none}
.bubble{position:absolute;right:clamp(110px,15vw,170px);bottom:clamp(120px,15vw,175px);background:var(--white);border:3px solid var(--ink);border-radius:18px;padding:8px 14px;font-family:var(--hand);font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;color:var(--barn);transform:rotate(-4deg);box-shadow:3px 3px 0 var(--ink);white-space:nowrap}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:no-preference){
  .rooster-perch .head{transform-origin:118px 70px;animation:crow 3.2s ease-in-out infinite}
  @keyframes crow{0%,70%,100%{transform:rotate(0)}78%{transform:rotate(-14deg)}88%{transform:rotate(-14deg)}}
}

/* sections */
section{padding-block:clamp(44px,7vw,80px)}
.two{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(24px,5vw,56px);align-items:start}
.stack{display:grid;gap:16px;min-width:0}

/* the dots story */
.dots-story{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
.dots-story h2{color:var(--mustard)}
.dots-story .eyebrow{color:var(--mustard)}
.dots-story blockquote{margin:0;font-size:clamp(1.2rem,2.6vw,1.55rem);line-height:1.5;font-style:italic;max-width:40ch}
.dotrow{display:flex;gap:14px;margin-top:6px}
.dotrow i{width:16px;height:16px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--paper);display:block}
.dotrow i:nth-child(2){opacity:.75}.dotrow i:nth-child(3){opacity:.5}

/* Shirley */
.shirley-facts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin-top:8px}
.fact{background:var(--white);border:2px solid var(--ink);border-radius:10px;padding:16px;display:grid;gap:4px;align-content:start}
.fact b{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:400;font-size:1.7rem;color:var(--barn);line-height:1.1;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
.fact span{font-size:.95rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}

/* recipe cards */
.shelf{background:var(--paper-2)}
.shelf-head{display:grid;gap:10px;max-width:60ch;margin-bottom:28px}
.cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px}
@media (max-width:760px){.cards{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}}
.card{background:var(--white);border-radius:6px;padding:18px 18px 16px;position:relative;border:2px solid var(--ink);
  background-image:repeating-linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 0 27px,rgba(47,74,99,.18) 27px 28px);background-position:0 46px}
.card::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:0;height:8px;border-radius:4px 4px 0 0}
.card.sweet::before{background:var(--mustard)}
.card.hard::before{background:var(--denim)}
.card h3{font-family:var(--hand);font-weight:700;font-size:1.3rem;color:var(--barn-dk);line-height:1.25;margin-top:4px}
.card p{font-size:.98rem;margin-top:6px;line-height:28px}
.legend{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:18px;margin-top:22px;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--ink-soft)}
.legend span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.legend i{width:26px;height:8px;border-radius:4px;display:inline-block}

/* why */
.why ol{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px 32px}
.why li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr;gap:14px;align-items:start}
.why li .n{font-family:var(--display);font-size:1.3rem;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--barn);color:var(--white);display:grid;place-items:center;border:3px solid var(--ink)}
.why h3{font-family:var(--body);font-weight:800;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--ink)}
.why li p{color:var(--ink-soft);margin-top:4px}

/* readers */
.readers{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.readers span{background:var(--white);border:2px dashed var(--barn);border-radius:999px;padding:8px 16px;font-weight:600;font-size:.95rem}

/* interview */
.radio{background:var(--denim);color:var(--white)}
.radio .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(20px,4vw,48px);align-items:center}
.radio h2{color:var(--mustard)}
.radio .eyebrow{color:#F3D58C}
.radio p{max-width:54ch}
.tv{width:clamp(150px,22vw,230px);display:block}

/* author */
.author{display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(20px,4vw,40px);align-items:start}
.polaroid{background:var(--white);padding:10px 10px 34px;border:2px solid var(--ink);transform:rotate(3deg);box-shadow:6px 6px 0 var(--ink);width:170px;text-align:center}
.polaroid img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;image-rendering:auto}
.polaroid span{font-family:var(--hand);font-size:1rem;display:block;margin-top:8px;color:var(--ink)}
.honors{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin-top:4px}
.honors span{background:var(--mustard);color:var(--ink);border-radius:6px;padding:4px 10px;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700}

/* back cover + final */
.porch{background:var(--barn);color:var(--white)}
.porch .wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(24px,5vw,56px);align-items:center}
.porch h2{color:var(--white)}
.porch .eyebrow{color:#FFD98A}
.porch .back{max-width:330px;justify-self:center;width:100%}
.porch .back img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:600/895;object-fit:cover;border:6px solid var(--white);box-shadow:-10px 12px 0 var(--barn-dk);transform:rotate(2deg)}
.porch .btn.buy{background:var(--white);color:var(--barn)}
.isbn{font-size:.9rem;opacity:.9;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}
footer{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
footer .wrap{padding-block:22px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px 20px;justify-content:space-between;font-size:.9rem}
footer a{color:var(--mustard)}

@media (max-width:760px){
  .hero .wrap,.two,.porch .wrap{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .cover{max-width:280px}
  .rooster-perch{width:110px}
  .bubble{right:96px;bottom:104px;font-size:.92rem}
  .hero .wrap{padding-bottom:150px}
  .why ol{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .shirley-facts{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .radio .wrap,.author{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .tv{width:150px}
  .porch .back{order:2;max-width:260px}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>


<svg width="0" height="0" style="position:absolute" aria-hidden="true">
  <defs>
    <symbol id="rooster" viewBox="0 0 200 220">
      <!-- fence post -->
      <rect x="62" y="168" width="70" height="52" fill="#8A5A34" stroke="#3A2617" stroke-width="4"/>
      <rect x="52" y="160" width="90" height="14" rx="3" fill="#A06B3F" stroke="#3A2617" stroke-width="4"/>
      <!-- legs -->
      <path d="M88 140 L84 162 M84 162 l-9 0 M84 162 l3 0 M106 140 L110 162 M110 162 l-8 0 M110 162 l6 0" stroke="#E0A426" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round" fill="none"/>
      <!-- tail -->
      <path d="M58 104 C20 70 18 30 40 18 C40 52 52 72 70 92Z" fill="#3E5B3A" stroke="#3A2617" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <path d="M60 110 C26 92 8 64 14 40 C30 70 46 84 70 98Z" fill="#2F4A63" stroke="#3A2617" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <path d="M62 118 C34 116 16 98 12 80 C32 96 48 102 72 106Z" fill="#E0A426" stroke="#3A2617" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <!-- body -->
      <path d="M60 104 C58 140 84 152 104 148 C130 144 140 120 132 96 C126 80 112 78 100 90 C88 100 72 96 60 104Z" fill="#A8322A" stroke="#3A2617" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <!-- wing -->
      <path d="M78 112 C88 104 108 106 114 118 C108 132 92 136 78 126Z" fill="#7C2019" stroke="#3A2617" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
      <path d="M84 120 h20 M86 126 h16" stroke="#E0A426" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <g class="head">
        <!-- neck + head -->
        <path d="M104 96 C102 74 106 56 118 50 C132 44 142 56 138 70 C136 82 132 92 130 100Z" fill="#E0A426" stroke="#3A2617" stroke-width="4" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <!-- comb -->
        <path d="M112 50 C110 40 118 36 120 44 C120 34 130 32 130 42 C134 34 144 38 138 50Z" fill="#D8392B" stroke="#3A2617" stroke-width="3.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <!-- beak (open: crowing) -->
        <path d="M138 60 L156 56 L139 66Z" fill="#F2C14E" stroke="#3A2617" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <path d="M138 68 L153 72 L137 73Z" fill="#F2C14E" stroke="#3A2617" stroke-width="3" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
        <!-- wattle -->
        <path d="M134 72 C140 78 138 88 132 86 C128 84 130 76 134 72Z" fill="#D8392B" stroke="#3A2617" stroke-width="3"/>
        <!-- brown eye -->
        <circle cx="128" cy="58" r="5.5" fill="#FFF9EC" stroke="#3A2617" stroke-width="2"/>
        <circle cx="129" cy="58" r="3.2" fill="#6B3A1E"/>
        <circle cx="130" cy="57" r="1" fill="#FFF9EC"/>
      </g>
    </symbol>
  </defs>
</svg>

<div class="sign">
  <div class="wrap">
    <b>Fresh from Mount Holly, Arkansas</b>
    <span>A family memoir of the Jim Crow South · Now available</span>
  </div>
</div>
<div class="gingham" role="presentation"></div>

<header class="hero">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="cover">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Front cover of The Black Dots: Stories of Resilience in the Jim Crow South, compiled and written by Barbara McHenry. A sepia family portrait in front of a cotton field, a church, and farmhouses." width="1000" height="1491">
      <div class="tag">Dozens of true stories</div>
    </div>
    <div class="hero-copy">
      <p class="eyebrow">Creative nonfiction · Southern history · Family memoir</p>
      <h1>The Black Dots<small>Stories of Resilience in the Jim Crow South</small></h1>
      <p class="byline">By Barbara McHenry · <em>Foreword by Dr. William McHenry</em></p>
      <p class="lede">A daughter’s loving tribute to her mother, Shirley Phillips, and to a family that met poverty, segregation, and grief with faith, hard work, laughter, and blackberry cobbler cooling on the counter.</p>
      <div class="btns">
        <a class="btn buy" href="https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HLYH4HPD?ref_=cm_sw_r_ffobk_cp_ud_dp_JDWQ7EWWTXPXVMSVM9WY_1&amp;bestFormat=true" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 19.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 1 6.5 17H20V3H6.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 0 4 5.5z"/><path d="M4 19.5A2.5 2.5 0 0 0 6.5 22H20v-5"/></svg>
          Buy the book on Amazon
        </a>
        <a class="btn watch" href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=shared&amp;v=qIQ75HuHKPk" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
          <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M8 5v14l11-7z"/></svg>
          Watch the interview
        </a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="bubble" aria-hidden="true">Cock-a-doodle-read!</div>
  <svg class="rooster-perch" viewBox="0 0 200 220" role="img" aria-label="A cheerful rooster crowing on a fence post"><use href="#rooster"/></svg>
</header>
<div class="gingham" role="presentation"></div>

<section class="dots-story">
  <div class="wrap two">
    <div class="stack">
      <p class="eyebrow">Where the title comes from</p>
      <h2>Ed’s Story: The Black Dots</h2>
      <div class="dotrow" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i></div>
    </div>
    <div class="stack">
      <blockquote>In rural Mount Holly, Arkansas, white parents had a way of making sure no one forgot who was Black. Every day before playtime, they marked the feet of a fair-skinned boy the community called “Light Ed” with black shoe polish, so the white children he played with would always know the difference.</blockquote>
      <p>Those black dots became this family’s enduring symbol of Jim Crow. Light Ed grew up to be Shirley Phillips’s father, and his story opens a book about everything his family built in spite of it.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section>
  <div class="wrap two">
    <div class="stack">
      <p class="eyebrow">The heart of the book</p>
      <h2>Meet Shirley Phillips</h2>
      <p>Shirley lost her own mother in childbirth and took charge of the newborn. She gave up high school to keep her family’s household running. Later she raised five children on a sawmill truck driver’s wages, and she met poverty, segregation, and grief without ever letting bitterness take root.</p>
      <p>Her daughter, Barbara McHenry, wrote this book so that Shirley’s courage, and the everyday heroism of families like hers, would never be forgotten.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="stack">
      <div class="shirley-facts">
        <div class="fact"><b>$40</b><span>a week on a sawmill truck driver’s wages</span></div>
        <div class="fact"><b>5</b><span>children raised with faith and grit</span></div>
        <div class="fact"><b>1800s–1970s</b><span>from the late 1800s through the Vietnam War</span></div>
      </div>
      <p class="hand" style="font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--barn-dk)">“A book for anyone who has ever had to seek light in a dark room.”</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="shelf">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="shelf-head">
      <p class="eyebrow">Straight from the pantry shelf</p>
      <h2>What you’ll find inside</h2>
      <p>Dozens of short, vivid stories hold laughter alongside hardship and faith alongside loss. Here’s a taste.</p>
    </div>
    <div class="cards">
      <article class="card sweet"><h3>Blackberry cobbler</h3><p>Cooling on the counter, and worth every scratch from the bramble.</p></article>
      <article class="card sweet"><h3>Christmas shoeboxes</h3><p>Filled with apples, oranges, and rock candy, and treasured all the same.</p></article>
      <article class="card sweet"><h3>The runaway hog</h3><p>Butchering time did not go according to plan.</p></article>
      <article class="card sweet"><h3>The party-line telephone</h3><p>One line, many listeners, and the whole town’s gossip.</p></article>
      <article class="card sweet"><h3>The leaky kitchen roof</h3><p>Every rain brought out the pots and pans.</p></article>
      <article class="card hard"><h3>The “Colored Only” door</h3><p>A hospital entrance that said everything about the era.</p></article>
      <article class="card hard"><h3>A beloved school, closed</h3><p>The Black school the community loved, shut down by integration.</p></article>
      <article class="card hard"><h3>Home from Vietnam</h3><p>A son who came back with wounds no uniform could show.</p></article>
      <article class="card hard"><h3>The valedictorian</h3><p>A daughter who carried her mother’s courage onto a newly integrated college campus.</p></article>
    </div>
    <div class="legend"><span><i style="background:var(--mustard)"></i>Laughter and home life</span><span><i style="background:var(--denim)"></i>Hardship and courage</span></div>
  </div>
</section>
<div class="gingham" role="presentation"></div>

<section class="why">
  <div class="wrap">
    <div class="shelf-head">
      <p class="eyebrow">Why this book matters</p>
      <h2>Four reasons to pull up a chair</h2>
    </div>
    <ol>
      <li><span class="n">1</span><div><h3>It saves history that was almost lost</h3><p>These stories were told on porches and around kitchen tables, rarely written down. Now they are preserved for good.</p></div></li>
      <li><span class="n">2</span><div><h3>It shows Jim Crow up close</h3><p>Through one family’s eyes, readers see how segregation shaped schools, hospitals, work, and childhood in the rural South.</p></div></li>
      <li><span class="n">3</span><div><h3>It celebrates joy, not just struggle</h3><p>Black families built community, faith, humor, and love in spite of the odds. This book honors all of it.</p></div></li>
      <li><span class="n">4</span><div><h3>It inspires families to tell their own stories</h3><p>Every family has a Shirley. This book shows how to remember, honor, and pass those stories on.</p></div></li>
    </ol>
  </div>
</section>

<section style="padding-top:0">
  <div class="wrap stack">
    <p class="eyebrow">Perfect for</p>
    <div class="readers">
      <span>Readers of Southern history</span>
      <span>Lovers of African American family memoir</span>
      <span>Book clubs and church groups</span>
      <span>Teachers and students</span>
      <span>Families preserving their own stories</span>
      <span>Grandparents and grandchildren reading together</span>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<section class="radio">
  <div class="wrap">
    <svg class="tv" viewBox="0 0 200 170" role="img" aria-label="A retro television">
      <path d="M70 30 L95 52 M130 24 L105 52" stroke="#F6E7C8" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <rect x="10" y="50" width="180" height="112" rx="18" fill="#A06B3F" stroke="#F6E7C8" stroke-width="5"/>
      <rect x="26" y="66" width="114" height="80" rx="12" fill="#F6E7C8"/>
      <path d="M72 88 v36 l30 -18z" fill="#A8322A"/>
      <circle cx="164" cy="84" r="10" fill="#E0A426" stroke="#3A2617" stroke-width="3"/>
      <circle cx="164" cy="114" r="10" fill="#E0A426" stroke="#3A2617" stroke-width="3"/>

<section>
  <div class="wrap author">
    <figure class="polaroid" style="margin:0">
      <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Portrait of author Barbara McHenry in a gray blazer" width="75" height="102">
      <span>Barbara McHenry</span>
    </figure>
    <div class="stack">
      <p class="eyebrow">About the author</p>
      <h2>A teacher with a story to tell</h2>
      <p>Barbara McHenry spent more than forty years in the classroom, beginning in Arkansas and teaching and counseling in Mississippi and Virginia. She grew up in a Southern community shaped by the quiet heroism of its elders, listening to stories that were rarely written down but deeply felt.</p>
      <div class="honors"><span>Mississippi Junior High English Teacher of the Year</span><span>Starkville’s first Outstanding Educator</span><span>Master’s in Counseling, Mississippi State</span></div>
      <p>Her mission is simple and profound: to remember, to honor, and to make sure these stories continue to live.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
